overview.summary: The quarterback position in fantasy football continues to be defined by a clear division between elite, dual-threat players who offer a high weekly floor and ceiling, and traditional pocket passers who rely on volume and efficiency. The 2024 season reinforced this trend, with mobile quarterbacks dominating the top of the fantasy leaderboards. As we look ahead to the 2025 season, a comprehensive strategy requires analyzing not only past performance but also critical off-season changes, including coaching adjustments, offensive personnel additions, and, most importantly, the strength of schedule. These factors combine to create a complex landscape where last year's heroes can become this year's disappointments, and new stars can emerge. This analysis synthesizes performance data from 2024 with forward-looking projections to provide a nuanced perspective on the most important position in fantasy football.
